I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I didn't run it, so it hasn't been tested against a database.

It does three things:
1. It backfills existing rows where `status` is NULL to `'queued'`. Without this, the NOT NULL step would fail on those rows.
2. It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. It sets the column to NOT NULL.

I left `001_init.sql` alone because migrations are append-only and it has already run in prod.

The backfill marks every existing NULL-status export as `'queued'`. If some of those jobs actually finished or failed, you may want a different value for them.
